description: This Java source file defines the Device class used within the Eclipse Hono project. It models device information, including properties like enabled status, extensions, defaults, and via addresses, and provides constructors, getters, and setters for these properties.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents device information within the Hono management service, including properties such as enabled status, extensions, defaults, and via addresses, with support for fluent interface chaining.
